I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.
We completely understand—when it comes to protecting your vehicle's battery, reliability is everything.
Battery Tender® products are engineered for dependability and long-term performance:
• Infinite Sequential Monitoring™ (ISM): Our proprietary 4-stage smart charging algorithm continuously checks battery health, charges safely, and automatically switches to float maintenance mode so it never overcharges your battery.
• Safety Built-In: Equipped with spark-proof connections, reverse polarity protection, and short-circuit safeguards to keep both your battery and vehicle electronics safe.
• Extreme Weather Performance: Built with automatic temperature compensation to adjust output in extreme heat or cold (working reliably from -4°F to 122°F).
• Trusted Warranty Protection: Depending on the model, our chargers are backed by long-term limited warranties (such as up to 10 years on classic models like the Battery Tender® Plus).
